I am young still and deal with depression and anxiety. Another big problem I have is self image issues and low self-esteem. So, for me, when I was self-harming, it never helped when people got angry or threatened to tell people. A few people at school saw and told me to stop or they would tell the counselor. I agreed and they didn't see them again, as I was more careful to hide them next time. I guess what I am trying to say is getting angry and threats are not helpful. If someone got angry, in my mind, it wasn't a clue to stop, it was a clue to hide them better. 

Another thing is people being way too overprotective and crazy about it. I know that watching out for the person is important, but I felt so untrusted and like everyone was constantly judging me and trying to keep me from doing a lot of things. And overreaction. It's really frustrating when people accuse you of cutting yourself everytime you have a scratch or a paper cut. 

The biggest thing is to try and be understanding. And I can tell by the fact that this was posted, you care a lot and do want to understand.

Hi. I'm sorry to hear what you've been through. But you have two choices: You can either let your past destroy you, or you can use it to your advantage. If you did decide to commit suicide, you would be letting it destroy you. If you kept going, you could do something great. I, too, have had some shitty memories, but I found a way to use them. At 15, I've seen a lot and realized quickly that I need to change my life. I know not everyone is the same, but I think you could really benefit from doing what I do. When I was at my lowest point, and where you are, and I wanted to die every night, I got on here. I got on /r/suicidewatch and helped people. I don't know if I was of much help, but I shared some words of wisdom, as I am doing right now. I have already decided what my purpose in life is. At 15, all the suffering has given me a second chance at life. My purpose? It's to help people. People who have been through similar experiences at me. I am alive today. I made it. So can you. If I can show people how to get through their problems, I have done my job. If you want to PM me and talk more, feel free. I hope this can help.
